LHX.sentence: L3Harris has fallen hard from its highs, and this one's worth watching because its profit margins are running well below its bigger defense rivals' — so this looks like genuine business strain, not just investors shuffling money around.

ASML.sentence: ASML is quiet and drifting up slightly — the stock looks pricey on its past year, but once you account for how fast chipmaking orders are expected to grow, it's more reasonable than it first appears.

LIN.sentence: Linde has pulled back a fair bit from its peak, but nothing has changed in the business — they still supply oxygen and nitrogen under long contracts and nudge prices up a little each quarter.

MSFT.sentence: Microsoft had a good day and the AI-cloud story keeps grinding along steadily, though it's been lagging a touch behind the other big tech names lately.

TMO.sentence: Thermo Fisher is steady, and there's an encouraging sign underneath — biotech funding has been thawing, and that money tends to turn into lab-equipment orders a couple of quarters down the road.

ENB.sentence: Enbridge is flat; its pipelines work like toll roads and pay a healthy dividend, but it's fairly priced right now rather than a genuine bargain.

NOW.sentence: ServiceNow is down meaningfully from its high but still outrunning other business-software peers, as big companies and government agencies keep signing up for its AI automation tools.

GLNCY.sentence: Glencore barely moved while copper miners jumped today, so this one is lagging the pack — which could mean it has some catching up to do.

MLM.sentence: Martin Marietta dipped slightly, and don't be fooled by a headline price-per-ton that looks like it fell — that's just a change in product mix; the real underlying price of their crushed rock is still climbing, which is what matters, and note this one is not actually as cheap as its reported earnings make it look.

KOF.sentence: The Latin American Coca-Cola bottler is barely moved, and with the Mexican peso holding steady — the main thing that sways this stock for US investors — there's nothing much to report.

PBR.A.sentence: Petrobras had a good day with oil prices high, but that's exactly the catch — its earnings are near the top of the cycle right now, so the big dividend is well-covered but the good times may not last.

AMKBY.sentence: Maersk, the container-shipping giant, is barely moved, and the whole fleet of ships is currently valued at less than it would cost to replace them — a classic sign the stock is cheap in a down part of the cycle.

MA.sentence: Mastercard climbed today and, unusually, is trading about in line with Visa rather than at its normal premium — people keep tapping their cards more than ever, so this is a rare moment where it looks relatively inexpensive.

ISRG.sentence: The da Vinci surgical robot maker had a good day but is still well below its high, even though hospitals keep doing more operations with its machines — a gap that looks more like fear than any real change in the business.
